description: This file contains the implementation of the TextFrameRenderer class, which is responsible for rendering TextFrame objects to RTF format in the MigraDoc document processing library.

classes.name: TextFrameRenderer
classes.description: Handles rendering of a TextFrame object into RTF format within the MigraDoc rendering process.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Main method to render a TextFrame into RTF, including setting properties and rendering contained elements.

methods.name: GetShapeHeight
methods.description: Gets the shape height, defaulting to 1 inch if not specified.

methods.name: GetShapeWidth
methods.description: Gets the shape width, defaulting to 1 inch if not specified.

methods.name: RenderLayoutPicture
methods.description: Creates a dummy picture placeholder within the RTF document to position the text frame.

methods.name: StartDummyParagraph
methods.description: Starts a dummy paragraph in RTF to embed shapes or special content.

methods.name: EndDummyParagraph
methods.description: Ends the dummy paragraph started for shape embedding.
